rv.q: The acting was flawless, the singing was striking, the costumes were perfect, the set transported us directly to the heart of Oz, and the lighting was the tool that brought everything together.
Whether it is your first visit to Oz or a return trip, this production delivers a thoroughly enjoyable night of theatre.
With Mayagoitia providing the fire and Bennett supplying the sparkle, this 'Wicked' remains what a touring Broadway production should be—lavish, accomplished and emotionally alive.
This is a finely honed, expertly crafted machine of a show, and every song, every design element, every performance, is perfection.
WICKED is just one of those shows that makes you fall in love with live theater all over again.
The show holds up beautifully 21 years after its Broadway premiere and eight months before the first half of an all-star major motion picture version gets released.
Not a moment of this Joe Mantello-directed 'Wicked' feels rote or phoned-in.
Don’t we all deserve some exhilarated mojo like this right about now?
Wicked is a splendid evening of theatre.
The musical from Broadway whiz Stephen Schwartz is bold and bewitching.
Stephen Schwartz’s remarkably clever and melody-driven songs are character-driven and move the action forward.
Wicked has enjoyed the opposite effect.
The cast was uniformly in top form, from Sharon Sachs as the steely scene-stealing Madame Morrible to DJ Plunkett’s love-torn Munchkin, Boq.
I really liked the show, and preferred Bohmer's Glinda to Ariana Grande's (who played the role in the 2024 movie).
Whatever the case, this 'Wicked' is solid, but not spectacular.
Time can reshape how some emotional material lands, and I can't help but notice how 'Wicked' ricochets in new and unexpected ways.

Visually, the production is stunning. Wicked has always been a feast for the eyes, and this tour fully delivers. cn.t: Critics praise Wicked's electric atmosphere and spectacular staging, with audiences responding enthusiastically to the beloved musical's return. The show delivers the magic and spectacle fans have been eagerly waiting for.
